profile.ja: 対魔忍ライブラリーこと佐郷文庫の娘。かつては父の姓・佐郷を名乗っていたが、父との離別から母方の姓である出雲を名乗るようになった。それはふうま方には属さないという彼女の決意であり、父への反発である。二車反乱事件の際に殺人鬼・斉藤半次郎に囚われるも風紀隊と主人公に救われた。その後、反乱以降の主人公の活躍を知ると、主人公の専属メイドに志願。主人公は断るが「私はそれしか命の恩人に報いる道を知りません。それが許されぬならばメイドらしく自害します」と切腹しようとするため仕方なく召し抱える事に。対魔忍ライブラリーが鶴の父であることは彼の希望で隠されている。「本当は御庭番となってお館様をお守りしたかったのですが、既にあなたがいるという事でメイドとなりました。どうぞお見知りおきを」というのが彼女が対魔忍ライブラリーと交わした最初の会話である。無機物から機巧を生成し使用する“機遁の術”使いで、手足をサイボーグ化した鶴はそのサイボーグアーム＆レッグを極力単純化しあえて機能を抑え、機遁の術で自在に手足を変化させる事に成功した。戦いにおいてはサイボーグアームをライフルに変化させたり、サイボーグレッグをブレード化したりと多彩な機巧変化で敵を翻弄する。「仇は倍返し、恩は百倍返し」が母の遺言であり彼女のモットー。
profile.en: She is the daughter of Taimanin Library, also known as Sago Bunko. She used to bear her father's surname, Sago, but after parting ways with him, she decided to take her mother's surname, Izumo, to signify her independence from the Fuuma clan and as a form of rebellion against her father. During the Gosha rebellion, she was captured by the killer Saito Hanjiro, but was rescued by the Moral Squad and the protagonist. After learning of the protagonist's achievements following the rebellion, she volunteered to become his exclusive maid. Although the protagonist declined, she insisted, saying, "This is the only way I know to repay my debt of gratitude. If it's not allowed, I'll commit seppuku as a maid." The fact that Taimanin Library is her father is being kept hidden at his request. Her first conversation with Taimanin Library was, "I actually wanted to become a court lady and protect the master, but since you're already here, I'll become a maid instead. Please take care of me." She is a user of the "Kitojutsu" technique, which allows her to generate and use machines from inorganic matter. She has cybernetic limbs, which she has simplified and suppressed in terms of function, allowing her to freely change them using her Kitojutsu technique. In battle, she can transform her cybernetic arms into rifles or her cybernetic legs into blades, using her technique to outmaneuver her enemies. Her motto, "Revenge is twice as sweet, gratitude is a hundred times as sweet," is a phrase passed down from her mother.

text.ja: 出雲鶴、御恩に報いるため参上仕りました。これからはご主人様のメイドとして、誠心誠意お仕えさせていただきます
text.en: I, Izumo Tsuru, have come to serve you as a token of my gratitude. From now on, I will devote myself to serving you as your maid, with all my heart and sincerity.

text.ja: お茶をお淹れしました。菓子も焼きましたのでご一緒に。こちらは明日のお着替えです。夕餉ですがいい魚が……え？　鶴は一人しかいませんが？
text.en: I've brewed some tea and baked some sweets, so please join me. I've also prepared your outfit for tomorrow. As for dinner, I found some nice fish, but... wait, am I the only one here?

text.ja: お屋敷では新参の身ですゆえ、出過ぎた真似はせぬよう弁えております……もちろん、いずれ全て私が引き受ける算段はしておりますが
text.en: As a newcomer to the mansion, I'm being careful not to overstep my bounds... but of course, I'm planning to take on all the responsibilities eventually.

text.ja: 命を粗末になどしておりません。本来であれば既にここにはないもの、そして今やご主人様が私の命そのものというだけです
text.en: I'm not taking my life lightly. Originally, I shouldn't even be here, and now my life belongs to you, Master.

text.ja: 仇は倍返し、恩は百倍返し……母から受け継いだ信念です。仇も恩も、きっちりと返させていただきます。たとえ死したとしても
text.en: Revenge is twice as sweet, gratitude is a hundred times as sweet... this is the creed I inherited from my mother. I'll make sure to repay both revenge and gratitude in full, even if it means dying.

text.ja: “路傍石”の能力、羨ましいです。私の場合ご主人様が一人になりたい時は、自害して霊となって見守るくらいしかありませんので……
text.en: I envy the "Roadside Stone" ability... in my case, if Master wants to be alone, I can only commit seppuku and watch over him as a spirit...

text.ja: 私に休暇ですか？　承知致しました、しばしのお暇を……ああっ、なぜ短刀を取り上げるのですか。不要になったゴミを処分するだけですのに
text.en: You're giving me a vacation? I understand, I'll take a break for a while... ah, why are you taking away my short sword? It's just useless trash that needs to be disposed of.

text.ja: ご主人様がどこへ参られようと、鶴は必ずついていきお世話を致します。それが冥途であっても……メイドだけに……ふふっ
text.en: No matter where Master goes, I'll always follow and take care of you... even if it's to the afterlife... that's what a maid is for... hehe.

text.ja: このような体ではございますが、溜まったモノを排泄するにはちょうどいい便所穴かと。いつでも股を開けとお命じ下さい
text.en: Although my body is like this, it's just right for a toilet hole to get rid of waste... please give me your orders anytime.

text.ja: ああっ、んんっ……優しくしないで下さい、勘違いしてしまいます。はぁぁ……いけません、こんな姿の女に情けなど……うぅぅ
text.en: Ah, don't be gentle with me, I might get the wrong idea... ha... it's not right for a woman like me to receive affection...

text.ja: あぁぁ……ご主人様ぁ……もっと鶴を縛って、戒めて下さい！　ああぁっ！　申し訳ございません、端女が主に懇願など……
text.en: Ah... Master... please tie me up and scold me more! Ah... I'm sorry, it's not right for a lowly maid like me to make such requests...
